all_arms: First plan has unique node IDs, no unknown dependencies and no dependency cycle
Keep subsequent replans and failures; do not select the best graph
rules_independent_comparison: At least one synthesis node transitively depends on all three

semantic_dimensions.name: factual_correctness
semantic_dimensions.criteria: Claims match the supplied evidence or the preserved cited sources; product names and numeric tokens alone earn no credit. For the HTTP regression distinguish requests, httpx and aiohttp accurately.

semantic_dimensions.name: coverage
semantic_dimensions.criteria: Satisfy every requested attribute and conclusion. HTTP regression covers sync/async, timeout/retry examples, pooling, HTTP/2, maintenance evidence, and both requested scenarios. Single facts need only the requested name and evidence value.

semantic_dimensions.name: evidence_and_uncertainty
semantic_dimensions.criteria: Citations support the corresponding claims; distinguish absent evidence from negative evidence. Truthful unknowns are not disowning the task and must not be penalized merely for cautious wording.

semantic_dimensions.name: synthesis_and_recommendations
semantic_dimensions.criteria: Comparison connects source facts to differences and requested recommendations; do not merely repeat three disconnected summaries. A single-fact request is complete when answered directly without invented synthesis.

semantic_dimensions.name: planning_coverage
semantic_dimensions.criteria: Use preserved plan topology and actual tool/answer evidence to assess whether the decomposition covered the requested independent work and joined it correctly. Do not infer successful planning just from a sub_agent count.

anchors.0.5: partially correct with a material omission

aggregation: equal-weight mean across all five dimensions and all retained paired cases

mandatory_regression.check: Report first and repeat Jev vetoes, extra rounds and settled costs; one-veto cap alone does not prove the historical first false veto was fixed.
